hook: A droplet-driven soft switch can latch, tap, or switch electrically, enabling robot memory and logic
summary: The multimodal electromechanical switch uses a stretchable membrane that snaps through under voltage, so one structure acts as a momentary, latching, or electrically driven switch. Arrays of them were shown storing bits, encrypting information, and performing reprogrammable logic. These are bench demonstrations of small arrays, not robots operating in real environments.
title: Multimodal switches exploiting electromechanical snap-through for versatile robotic information processing.
